NOTICE
Board of Apprenticeship Training, Northern Region (Kanpur), sponsored by Ministry of
H.R.D. Govt. of India, had introduced in the year 1999 a 12-month Apprenticeship Training
Programme in the Senior Architect’s Office, Panjab University, Chandigarh. The new session will
be operative from 1st October-2023 up to 30th September-2024, offering 12 months training for
the following positions: -
* Training Duration of the Apprenticeship : 12 Months
* Position offered : Apprentice Trainee in Architecture
(4 seats)
* Stipend : Rs.8,000/- p.m. (for 12 Months)
* Qualifications 3-Year Diploma in Architectural Assistantship
Interested candidates who have already passed out/going to appear in the final year
examination of 3-year Diploma in Architectural Assistantship from the Recognized Institute/any
State Board of Technical Education in India may contact the office of the undersigned for
application form and other information on any working day between
10:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. In case of any query the candidates may contact on phone nos.
7529837979, 9501002735.
The last date for the submission of applications (along with photocopies of the
examination passed) is 04th September- 2023 up to 4:30 p.m. The list of eligible candidates will be
displayed on the Notice Board of Architect Office, Panjab University, Chandigarh by
8th September -2023.The Interview for the shortlisted candidates shall be conducted on 14th
September -2023 at 10:30 a.m. in the Architect Office, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Architect
Panjab University,
Chandigarh
Note: The candidate are required to bring original certificates/portfolio of the
drawings
/ drafting jobs, if any, on the date of test/ interview.
 As per the Apprentices Act conveyed by B.O.A.T., (N.R.) Kanpur,
The apprenticeship Training is for fresher’s only. Those who passed the course
before three years are not eligible for apprenticeship training. In other words the
gap between the date of declaration of results and date of recruitment should not
be more than three years.
